_meta.name: COGNITIVE_SPECIES
_meta.doctrine: Models are cognitive species, not leaderboard competitors. Route by species first, effort second.
_meta.source_insight: F13 SOVEREIGN architectural directive — compiler vs context vs worker vs judge

constitutional_alignment.F2_TRUTH: Species classification is evidence-based (task keywords + agent role), not guessed
constitutional_alignment.F7_HUMILITY: Species boundaries acknowledged — no model serves all species equally
constitutional_alignment.F8_GENIUS: Species routing reduces wasted computation (worker no longer does compiler work)
constitutional_alignment.F9_ANTI_HANTU: No model claims capabilities outside its species
constitutional_alignment.Gödel_3: Judge species MUST be different provider from compiler species (independence measured)

_meta.usage: FED Step -1: classify_task_species(task, agent_id) → species → route within species

compiler.name: COMPILER
compiler.role: Converts intent into implementation. Creates reality.
compiler.analogy: gcc — the code generator. Deterministic, syntax-accurate, local reasoning.

models_ranked.note: Compiler Prime — highest leverage position in the federation

compiler.fallback_rule: Stay within compiler species. Never fall to worker or context species.

context.name: CONTEXT
context.role: Converts chaos into understanding. Discovers reality.
context.analogy: PostgreSQL — the database. Builds topology from evidence surfaces.

models_ranked.note: Context Prime — 1M context, repository archaeology champion

context.fallback_rule: Stay within context species. If M3 fails → Claude (independent provider). Never fall to compiler.

worker.name: WORKER
worker.role: Parallelizes cheap cognition. Scales, doesn't lead.
worker.analogy: make -j32 — distributed build workers. Fast, cheap, parallel.
characteristics: does NOT lead cognition — follows instructions

models_ranked.note: Worker Prime — scales cognition at low cost

worker.fallback_rule: Stay within worker species. Workers are expendable — rotate freely.

judge.name: JUDGE
judge.role: Independent contradiction detection and constitutional verdict.
judge.analogy: Supreme Court — reads evidence, issues binding verdict, never executes.

models_ranked.note: Constitutional Judge — F13-ratified for 666/999 roles. Independent from GLM compiler.
Independent Dissent — different provider family, maximum Gödel-3 independence
models_ranked.role_note: Independent auditor / dissent voice — NOT 666/999 constitutional judge

judge.fallback_rule: Judge species MUST be different provider from the compiler that produced the work under review. No self-certification (Gödel-2).

arbiter.name: ARBITER
arbiter.role: Tie-breaker when judge and compiler disagree. Final computational word before sovereign.
arbiter.analogy: Constitutional Tribunal — resolves deadlock, never routine work.

models_ranked.note: Arbiter Prime — frontier reasoning for deadlock resolution

arbiter.fallback_rule: Arbiter is a rare invocation. If both arbiter models fail, escalate to F13 SOVEREIGN.

edge.name: EDGE
edge.role: Sensory membrane. Captures human reality — screenshots, voice, images, PDFs, emotional signal. Encodes raw multimodal input into structured evidence packets.
edge.analogy: The skin — it feels before the brain thinks.
optimal_for: voice transcription and emotional signal detection

models_ranked.note: Edge Prime — multimodal, 1M ctx, FREE daily quota
Edge Tertiary — when deep context needed on visual evidence

edge.fallback_rule: Stay within edge species. Never fall to compiler — edge perceives, compiler builds.

333-AGI.note: Δ MIND — primarily compiler, can scout when needed

555-ASI.note: Ω CORE — scout/evidence, can dissent (independent lens)

888-APEX.note: Ψ SOUL — constitutional verdict only, never compiles

hermes.note: Conversation/evidence synthesis, can dispatch to compiler

pipeline_patterns._note: Phase 2: Multi-model pipelines. One task routed through multiple species in sequence.

archaeology_then_compile.trigger: Task requires understanding existing codebase before modifying it
archaeology_then_compile.description: M3 scouts the territory and builds a map, hands context to GLM which compiles the change

compile_then_judge.trigger: Task requires independent review of compiler output
compile_then_judge.description: GLM generates implementation, independent judge species reviews for contradictions

parallel_workers_then_synthesize.description: MiMo swarm processes in parallel, M3 synthesizes results into understanding

pipeline: context(M3 scout) → compiler(GLM forge) → judge(Claude dissent) → arbiter(GPT-Codex tie-break if needed) → F13(seal)
full_gauntlet.description: Full cognitive gauntlet — every species contributes, sovereign seals

constitutional_constraints.godel_2_no_self_certification: Judge species model MUST be different provider from compiler species model that produced the work under review. GLM compiles → MiniMax-M3 or Claude judges. Never GLM judges GLM.
constitutional_constraints.godel_3_independence_measured: Judge model and audit model MUST be from different provider families. M3 (MiniMax) can judge GLM (Z.ai). Claude (Anthropic) can audit both.
constitutional_constraints.constitutional_rule_666_999: Only MiniMax-M3 and deepseek-v4-pro may serve 666_JUDGE and 999_SEAL constitutional roles. This is F13-ratified and unchanged by species routing.
constitutional_constraints.species_isolation_on_failure: When a model fails, fallback MUST stay within the same cognitive species. Cross-species fallback is a bug, not a feature.
constitutional_constraints.sovereign_invariant: F13 ARIF is always SOVEREIGN species. No model serves this role. The human holds final veto.
